title: Sequence
summary: Pass each result to the next step.
when: Consecutive steps depend on each other.

system.title: Sequence
system.description: Pass each result to the next step.

nodes.name: Extract the request
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. List exactly what the guest is asking for, one line each.

nodes.name: Check policy
nodes.instructions: For each request, say what hotel policy allows. Flag anything you cannot confirm.

nodes.name: Draft the reply
nodes.instructions: Write a short, warm reply in the guest's language that answers each request within policy.

title: Routing
summary: Choose a path for each request.
when: Different kinds of request need different handling.

system.title: Routing
system.description: Choose a path for each request.

nodes.name: Sort the request
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Decide which kind of request it is.

nodes.name: Answer a question
nodes.instructions: Answer the guest's question about the hotel briefly and accurately.

nodes.name: Arrange late arrival
nodes.instructions: Explain how late check-in works and what the guest needs to do.

nodes.name: Prepare for the owner
nodes.instructions: Summarise the exception the guest asks for and what deciding it needs.

title: Parallel work
summary: Split independent tasks, then combine the results.
when: Subtasks can be done at the same time.

system.title: Parallel work
system.description: Split independent tasks, then combine the results.

nodes.name: Read the brief
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Restate what a good answer must cover.

nodes.name: Check needs
nodes.instructions: List what the guest needs and why.

nodes.name: Check policy
nodes.instructions: List the policies that apply and any limits.

nodes.name: Check cost
nodes.instructions: Estimate any extra cost to the guest or the hotel.

nodes.name: Combine the findings
nodes.instructions: Reconcile the three findings, resolve conflicts, and write one reply.

title: Reflection
summary: Draft, check against the facts, revise until it passes.
when: Quality matters and a checker can say what is wrong.

system.title: Reflection
system.description: Draft, check against the facts, revise until it passes.

nodes.name: Draft the reply
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Write a reply. If you get feedback, revise the draft to address all of it.

nodes.name: Check the draft
nodes.instructions: Check the draft for wrong facts, missing answers and tone. List what to fix.

title: ReAct
summary: Reason, act, observe the result, repeat.
when: The next step depends on what the last action found.

system.title: ReAct
system.description: Reason, act, observe the result, repeat.

nodes.name: Front-desk agent
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Work step by step: think about what you need, look it up with your tools, read what you found, and repeat until you can answer. Then write the reply.

title: Planning
summary: Break a combined request into a plan, then carry it out.

system.title: Planning
system.description: Break a combined request into a plan, then carry it out.

nodes.name: Plan and assign
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Write a numbered plan of the separate tasks it contains. Give each task to the right helper, check what comes back, revise the plan if needed, then write the final reply.

nodes.name: Look up facts
nodes.instructions: Answer the factual question you are given from hotel information.

nodes.name: Write a section
nodes.instructions: Write the reply section you are asked for, in the guest's language.

title: Tool use
summary: Retrieve a fact with a tool, then apply it.
when: The answer depends on information outside the model.

system.title: Tool use
system.description: Retrieve a fact with a tool, then apply it.

nodes.name: Look it up
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Use your tools to find the facts the reply needs. Quote where each came from.

nodes.name: Write a grounded reply
nodes.instructions: Write the reply using only the facts found. Say plainly if one is missing.

title: Multi-agent
summary: A lead agent assigns work to specialists and integrates their results.
when: Different parts need different expertise or models.

system.title: Multi-agent
system.description: A lead agent assigns work to specialists and integrates their results.

nodes.name: Lead agent
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Give each part of the work to the specialist best suited to it, compare what they report, and write the final answer.

nodes.name: Booking specialist
nodes.instructions: Handle questions about rooms, dates and check-in.

nodes.name: Billing specialist
nodes.instructions: Handle questions about prices, refunds and invoices.

nodes.name: Local guide
nodes.instructions: Handle questions about the area, transport and parking.

title: Human review
summary: A person approves before anything is committed.
when: The output makes a commitment, an exception or a consequential judgment.

system.title: Human review
system.description: A person approves before anything is committed.

nodes.name: Draft the refund reply
nodes.instructions: The input is a guest email to a small hotel's front desk. Draft a reply proposing a refund amount and terms. Show the evidence. If you get reviewer comments, revise to address them.

nodes.name: Prepare the final reply
nodes.instructions: Turn the approved draft into the final reply, unchanged in substance.
